name: ab_checked_arithmetic_every_estimate_producer
title: Checked arithmetic across every estimate producer
text: Numerical-range repairs must cover every production path calculating the same quantity, including stored solver metadata. A protected reporting helper does not protect an unchecked upstream accumulator.
trigger: Adaptive accumulator uses overflow-prone trapezoid formula returning inf when correct floating-point result is finite
check: Extend code/tests/test_numerical_refusal.py::test_large_finite_trapezoid_does_not_overflow_its_mean with the adaptive fixture, requiring a finite estimate near 1.2e305. Include an unrepresentable case that must raise NumericalRefusalError.
